name: CIPLE (Certificado Inicial de Português Língua Estrangeira)
issuer: CAPLE, Faculdade de Letras da Universidade de Lisboa
sections: Reading + Written production/interaction (75 min, 45%); Listening (30 min, 30%); Speaking (15 min, 25%)
pass_rule: 55% overall (CAPLE classification scale 55-100%). No per-section minimum.
accepted_for: Proof of Portuguese language for Portuguese nationality (naturalisation) under the Regulamento da Nacionalidade (DL 237-A/2006). Lei Orgânica 1/2026 (in force 2026-05-19) adds culture/history/civic knowledge requirements; the implementing regulation had not been updated by the verified date.

name: DELE A2 (Diploma de Español como Lengua Extranjera)
sections: Reading comprehension (60 min, 25 pts); Listening comprehension (40 min, 25 pts); Written expression and interaction (45 min, 25 pts); Oral expression and interaction (12 min, 25 pts)
pass_rule: APTO requires at least 30/50 in Group 1 (reading + writing) AND at least 30/50 in Group 2 (listening + speaking). Max 100 points.
accepted_for: Spanish nationality by residence: DELE A2 or higher (unless exempt) plus the CCSE test.

name: CCSE (Conocimientos Constitucionales y Socioculturales de España)
accepted_for: Spanish nationality by residence (together with DELE A2+). Held only in Spain.

name: DELF A2 tout public (Diplôme d'études en langue française)
issuer: France Éducation international (French Ministry of Education)
sections: Listening (25 min, 25 pts); Reading (30 min, 25 pts); Writing (45 min, 25 pts); Speaking (6-8 min, 25 pts)
pass_rule: At least 50/100 overall and at least 5/25 in each of the 4 papers (below 5/25 is eliminatory).
accepted_for: Proof of French A2 for a first multi-year residence card (carte de séjour pluriannuelle) since 2026-01-01.

name: DELF B1 tout public (Diplôme d'études en langue française)
issuer: France Éducation international (French Ministry of Education)
sections: Listening (25 min, 25 pts); Reading (45 min, 25 pts); Writing (45 min, 25 pts); Speaking (15 min, 25 pts)
pass_rule: At least 50/100 overall and at least 5/25 in each of the 4 papers (below 5/25 is eliminatory).
accepted_for: Proof of French B1 for a first 10-year resident card (carte de résident) since 2026-01-01.

name: DELF B2 tout public (Diplôme d'études en langue française)
issuer: France Éducation international (French Ministry of Education)
sections: Listening (30 min, 25 pts); Reading (60 min, 25 pts); Writing (60 min, 25 pts); Speaking (20 min, 25 pts)
pass_rule: At least 50/100 overall and at least 5/25 in each of the 4 papers (below 5/25 is eliminatory).
accepted_for: Naturalisation requires B2 oral and written since 2026-01-01; DELF B2 is a CEFR B2 diploma (check the accepted-document list on service-public.gouv.fr).

name: CELI 2 (Certificato di Conoscenza della Lingua Italiana, livello B1)
issuer: CVCL, Università per Stranieri di Perugia
sections: Reading (Part A) (25%, 40 pts); Writing (Part B) (25%, 40 pts); Listening (Part C) (20 min, 25%, 40 pts); Speaking (10-12 min, 25%, 40 pts)
pass_rule: At least 72/120 in the written test and at least 22/40 in the oral; pass band 94-160 (grades A/B/C).
fee: 120 EUR (Italy - Perugia centre, CELI Standard (Mar/Jun/Nov)); 65 EUR (Italy - Perugia centre, CELI Immigrati B1 / CELI 2 i cittadinanza (Feb/May/Sep))
accepted_for: Italian citizenship (art. 9.1 L. 91/1992): B1 certificate from a recognised body (CELI/Perugia, CILS/Siena, CERT.IT/Roma Tre, PLIDA/Dante Alighieri).
